Satellite name T-LogoQube (BeakerSat 1, MagPocketQube, Eagle-1)
Form factor PocketQube
Units or mass PocketQube 2.5p
Status Reentry 2019-02-13. Was operational until?
Launched 2013-11-21
NORAD ID 39437
Deployer MRFOD (Morehead Rome Femtosatellites Orbital Deployer)
Launcher Dnepr
Deployment Deployed from UniSat-5 on 2013-11-29
Organization Sonoma State University
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Headquarters US
Launch brokerer GAUSS
Partners Morehead State University
Oneliner

Simple attitude determination experiments based on magnetic field.
Description

T-LogoQube is measuring the Earth's magnetic field in order to determine the satellite's pointing direction.
Notes

Had CZT array payload but did not fly in the end. Deployed from UniSat-5.
